data.name: Luka
data.gender_notes: Luka is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word ‘lucus’, meaning ‘bright’, ‘shining’, or ‘light’. In Christian tradition, the name Luka is associated with St. Luke, the patron saint of artists, physicians, and surgeons. The name Luka carries the meaning “Bright, Shining” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Luka usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A beacon of light in the spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Luka belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bright, Shining.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Luka total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: לוקא
in_hebrew.meaning: לוּקָא הוּא שֵׁם שֶׁל מְגִילָה בַּתּוֹרָה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: לוּקָא שֵׁם שֶׁל מְגִילָה בַּתּוֹרָה, מִתְאָרֵךְ לְגַמָדִים וְלִפְרָשׂוֹת שֶׁל דְּבָרִים הַמְקוֹרִיִּים בְּקִרְבָּנוֹת הָאֱלֹהִים. הוּא קֶשֶׁר לַעֲמוּדָה וְלִפְרָשָׂה שֶׁל הַמְשׁוֹרֵר בַּכְנֵי הָאֱלֹהִים.

in_greek.name: Λουκάς
in_greek.meaning: Λουκάς ο ευαγγελιστής και συνοδός του Παύλου
in_greek.long_meaning: Λουκάς σημαίνει 'ο φέγγος' ή 'ο λευκός', συνδέεται με την αποστολή του Ευαγγελιστή Λουκά, συγγραφέα του Ευαγγελίου και των Πραξεων των Αποστόλων, που ήταν σύντροφος του Αποστόλου Παύλου και ιατρός.

in_latin.name: Lucas
in_latin.long_meaning: Lucas nomen derivatur a latino 'lux', quod lucem significat. Lucas in Ecclesia primitiva erat sanctus et evangelista, medicus et scriptor Actuum Apostolorum et Evangelii secundum Lucam.

in_english.name: Luka
in_english.meaning: Bringer of light, born at dawn or morning light
in_english.long_meaning: The name Luka is derived from the Latin 'lux', meaning light. It is associated with Saint Luke, the evangelist and companion of Saint Paul, who wrote the Gospel of Luke and the Acts of the Apostles. Luka symbolizes illumination, knowledge, and spiritual guidance. Historically, the name has been popularized in various Christian cultures, reflecting its biblical and apostolic roots.

data.cultural_impact: The name Luka holds a rich cultural significance due to its illustrious namesake, St. Luke, who was a prominent Early Christian figure. He was a physician by profession, one of the Seven Deacons, and a close associate of St. Paul. St. Luke is known for his authorship of the Gospel of Luke, the Acts of the Apostles, and several Pauline epistles. The name Luka is also popularly associated with St. Luke of Crimea, a 14th-century monk, theologian, and archbishop, who played a crucial role in the spread of Christianity throughout Eastern Europe and Asia.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Luka carries deep spiritual significance, as it is rooted in the light-filled ideals of radiance, clarity, and illumination. In a Christian context, the name Luka is strongly linked to St. Luke's unwavering dedication to uncovering and sharing the divine truth. His name symbolizes the pursuit of wisdom and understanding, as well as the power of healing and nurturing that comes from God's endless love. For those bearing the name Luka, they are reminded to emulate St. Luke's example as a seeker of truth, a healer, and a devout servant of God.
